name: focusdock
description: Minimal Personal To-Do & Reminder Desktop Companion for Windows
author: Tilak

scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/index.ts src/main/preload.ts --out-dir dist/main --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/index.ts src/main/preload.ts --out-dir dist/main --format cjs --watch --external electron
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "tsup src/main/index.ts src/main/preload.ts --out-dir dist/main --format cjs --watch" "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
